text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having finished her Debut race, Tosen 
Jordan felt the burning passion for racing 
ignite deep within her heart.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She may not be in the spotlight as much as 
other Umamusume right now... but she vows 
once again that she will make it big from 
here on out.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For that, I have to prove what I'm capable 
of first! On the Trainer's recommendation, 
the Junior-class GⅠ Hopeful Stakes was 
chosen as the next target.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...Behind her Trainer's back, quietly 
studying races on her own all the while.
